verdict.rationale: Clara's agent instructions document a first-party Clara MCP for cases where a user wants an AI assistant to inspect or act on Clara data in natural language, such as listing cards, reviewing transactions and switching companies. This is a real natural-language operation path, but it runs through an external assistant and the evidence is a single thin mention. The pack also documents agent guardrails for money-moving actions (Pix payments) and LLM-optimized docs that support agent use. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, documented MCP tool coverage showing which operations can be done in natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
